overall_notes: This paper presents a thorough evaluation of neural text generation models for legal text generation, specifically for generating descriptions of criminal court dockets. The paper includes both automatic metrics and detailed human evaluation with legal experts. The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only normalization and consolidation of duplicate entries.
